raw_response:
I am young, only 21, but this maize plot is what will feed my family this year. I farm 0.63 hectares here in Ntcheu, and like most farmers around me I hope to get a fertilizer coupon from FISP — without it I cannot afford much fertilizer at market price. I will plant hybrid seed if I can get it through the subsidy, and intercrop with beans or pigeon pea as we always do to spread the risk. I rely on rain, not irrigation, and most of the work I do myself with help from my family.
